name: standard
about: The standard settings, as every run starts

name: after-plague
about: A plague has just carried off a third of the people: land to spare, labour scarce

name: crowded
about: Half as many people again as the land feeds well; the soil tired, the woods thinned

name: lean-barns
about: After a bad harvest: a month of food in store, and half the usual savings

name: full-barns
about: After a run of good harvests: a year of food in store

name: short-of-coin
about: Coin is scarce: a third of the usual savings and business cash

name: heavy-lords
about: The lords and the state take twice as much: twice the demesne and labour days, twice the tax

name: free-peasants
about: No lords, half the tax, and more families holding land

name: unequal
about: Land in few hands: half the families landless, the rest's holdings more uneven

name: in-debt
about: Landholding families owe a year and a half's wage to the biggest landholders, and have half the usual savings

name: war-torn
about: After a war: a seventh of the people gone, the rest weakened, barns and herds plundered

name: worn-land
about: Soil worn out and woods cut back by generations of crowding

name: open-trade
about: Good roads and rivers: carting costs halved, twice the grain trade beyond the region

name: closed
about: No grain trade with the world beyond the region

name: no-garrison
about: The state spends none of its tax in the city

name: few-ironworkers
about: A mine flooded and a fever went through the iron hills: a quarter of the usual ironworkers

name: village-crafts
about: Only the village's four crafts: no iron, salt, pots or lead, no crafts sold beyond the region
